bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; providing temporary authority to store drill cores outside the drill core library.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+TEMPORARY DRILL CORE STORAGE. +]

[+(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 93.61, the commissioner of natural resources may store drill cores at locations other than the drill core library as necessary when space is limited. The commissioner may limit or prohibit access to those drill cores to protect public safety and the drill cores from damage. +]

[+(b) This section expires June 30, 2029. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; providing temporary authority to store drill cores outside the drill core library.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TEMPORARY DRILL CORE STORAGE.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 93.61, the commissioner of natural resources may store drill cores at locations other than the drill core library as necessary when space is limited. The commissioner may limit or prohibit access to those drill cores to protect public safety and the drill cores from damage.

(b) This section expires June 30, 2029.
additions: (a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 93.61, the commissioner of natural resources may store drill cores at locations other than the drill core library as necessary when space is limited. The commissioner may limit or prohibit access to those drill cores to protect public safety and the drill cores from damage.
